verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a product-analytics platform, since some competitors offer self-hosted deployments, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Pendo can be self-hosted. The JavaScript snippet, SDK and Launcher installs only instrument client apps that send data to Pendo. Data Sync exports to Snowflake, S3, Azure or Google Cloud are an adjacent data-portability feature, not self-hosting of the core product.
